title: list view: a row's built-in Edit / Delete greyed by userActions.*.disabledWhen gives no reason, unlike the record page since #35135
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #35135 dev (os-dev-report 6997604349, PR #35288 Acceptance notes), read in code; named as owed by the L1-a reviewer (ACCEPT 6998025008). Follow-up of #35135, nested under it.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, published `@object-ui/components`). Suggested-grade: p2 · same reach and same ruling as #35135 (UX × not every user every time).
Dedupe: `row action disabledWhen reason`, `data-table builtin disabled reason` — none open.

## 维护者速读

列表里每一行的「编辑」「删除」菜单项，在对象写了 `userActions.edit/delete.disabledWhen` 且条件成立时会变灰，但不说原因。#35135（PR #35288）已按你的裁定 B 给记录页的同一情况加了通用原因「对此记录不可用」；列表行是同一缺口的另一处。

## Facts (origin/main)

- `data-table.tsx` ~:726-737: the built-in row item evaluates `useRowPredicate(predicates?.disabledWhen, row, …)` and renders `<DropdownMenuItem disabled={disabled} …>` with no reason, no title and no accessible description.
- Ruling 6996106574 (route B on #35135): the generic `actions.notAvailableForRecord` sentence, no protocol change, no new key.

## Ask

Apply route B to the list row's built-in Edit / Delete: when the declared `disabledWhen` is what greys the item, show the existing `actions.notAvailableForRecord` sentence (visible second line or description, matching #35288's overflow entry). Pins: a disabledWhen-greyed row item shows the reason; CONTROL: an enabled item and an item whose predicate does not hold show none. Ablate red. `Clause-②: no` expected.

⛔ Not a claim.
